description: Tensor-parallel all-reduce (sum), optionally fused with the following residual add + RMSNorm: aiter custom all-reduce, quick all-reduce, RCCL. Needs the multi-rank harness of collective-ut.md; the single-process leg runner cannot test it.

inputs.doc: rank r contributes inputs[r]; the rank harness scatters it

call: The rank harness (collective-ut.md) runs call on every rank with that rank's slice and returns rank 0's result; every rank's result must be identical — compare all of them, not only rank 0.

timing.cache: time on the deployment's world size and the exact GPUs it uses (XGMI topology); report per-rank max, not rank 0.

negative_controls: skip the last rank's contribution: error ~|inputs[world-1]|
reduce in bf16 instead of fp32 for one-shot: a biased error the bias test catches at large world
pitfalls: Quick all-reduce variants quantize the payload (fp8/int4) on the wire: their error is the baseline's own and baseline_relative bounds the candidate by it; a tolerance chosen for bf16 would reject the installed kernel.
Ranks must agree bit for bit with each other even when the reduction order makes them differ from the float64 sum.
A collective timed on GPUs that are not the deployment's peers measures the wrong links.
